sanjay: Kickoff 1: need final decisions on quota-decay, emergency spillback, and how burst envelopes show up in invoices. Roadmap owners need commit by EOD Thu.

elaine: TLDR: must-have for pilot = stable spillback semantics (predictable ordering) + clear quota-decay policy so customers know how fast unused allowances disappear. Billing can be delayed but schema must exist.

jules: Proposed quota-decay model: exponential decay that halves allowance every 24h of inactivity. Rationale: encourages steady usage and prevents long tail carryover abuse. Configurable per-contract.

nick: Ops concern: exponential decay might be surprising in support cases. Suggest linear decay with a clearly documented window (e.g., full expiration after 7d) and churn telemetry for disputed invoices.

elaine: Commercial note: customers want an "emergency spillback" toggle that lets them opt into aggressive fallback to shared pools during spikes. That would reduce tail latency but could break strict isolation promises. We need legal signoff.

sanjay: We should differentiate two behaviors: spill_to_shared = best_effort (default) and spill_to_shared_strict = off for enterprise with isolation SLAs. Default = on for self-serve, off for reserved contracts.

jules: Autoscale policy decision: use dual-threshold with hysteresis. Trigger scale-up when sustained occupancy > 75% for 10m; scale-down when < 40% for 15m. Also cap scale frequency to 1 change per 12m to avoid thrash.

nick: Add guard: if shared_pool_spill_rate > 1% for 5m, prioritize adding capacity instead of immediate tenant preemption. That helps noisy neighbors.

elaine: Billing-bot: can we attach a preliminary billing event model? We need events for: burst_grant, burst_consumed, carryover_applied, decay_applied, spill_to_shared.

billing-bot: ack: draft events created. Schema link: https://internal.redwood/billing/events#reserve (internal).

sanjay: UX: how do we surface burst envelopes? Suggest: routes list shows "Burst envelope: X tokens / 5m, carryover: on/off, decay-window: 7d". Also surface a "historical usage" chart grouped by envelope periods.

jules: For pilot, scope to per-tenant envelope view + alerts when consumption > 80% of envelope. Full per-route breakdown can follow.

nick: Runbook ask: create an oncall play for accidental full-spill: checklist to identify tenant, check last-scale, toggle emergency spillback. I can draft.

elaine: Commercial: offer "rollover" as an add-on (monthly charge) with SLA that guarantees a fraction of unused burst will carry. This will satisfy customers who want predictability and is revenue positive.

sanjay: Decisions for roadmap:
- Default spill_to_shared = on for self-serve, off for enterprise (must opt-in to spill for enterprise).
- Quota decay = linear default with 7d expiration, contract-configurable; expose as decay-window in UI.
- Autoscale = dual-threshold with hysteresis + 12m rate-limit.
- Pilot scope = deterministic spill ordering + envelope UI + billing event draft + oncall runbook.

elaine: Owners: sanjay (product + contracts), jules (policy + runtime hooks), nick (infra + runbook), elaine (pricing + billing schema). Dev ETA 5w for pilot-ready flag behind feature toggle.

sanjay: Ok scheduling note: demo to sales ops Tue next week. Please surface any major objections now.

nick: No objections. Will start runbook draft today.

jules: I'll push the runtime hooks as PRs and include a config spec. Example snippet:```json
{"reserve": {"spill_order": ["priority","age"], "decay_window_days": 7, "spill_to_shared_default": true, "autoscale": {"up_threshold_pct": 75, "up_duration_mins": 10, "down_threshold_pct": 40, "down_duration_mins": 15, "min_toggle_minutes": 12}}}```

elaine: Thanks team. Closing this thread; follow-up 1:1s for contracts/legal. :wave:
